title: Effects of Pentoxifylline and Vitamin E on Pregnancy Rate in Infertile Women Treated by ICSI:
brief_summary: Our findings will provide preliminary clinical evidence to suggest the new experimental treatment approaches, toward female factor infertility treatment with pentoxyfylline.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* infertile female patients under 39 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* hypothalamic amenorrhea
* drug reactions or complications
* endometrioses
* fibroids
